focused_scope.cressie_read_2_3_outside_log_formula: O'_i = O_i + δ (additive count smoothing, all cells). N' = N + δ × K. E'_i = N'/K (uniform null, smoothed expected). T_(2/3)(δ) = (9/5) × Σ_i O'_i × ((O'_i / E'_i)^(2/3) - 1) = 1.8 × Σ O' × ((O'/E')^(2/3) - 1) (Cressie & Read 1984 §3 power divergence λ=2/3 recommended form). coefficient = 2 / (λ × (λ + 1)) = 2 / ((2/3) × (5/3)) = 2 / (10/9) = 9/5 = 1.8.
focused_scope.conv_3_inside_log_formula_reference: T_sym(δ) = 2 Σ_{all i} (E_i + δ) × log((E_i + δ) / (O_i + δ)). dc2038f baseline.
focused_scope.method_2_pearson_outside_log_formula_ref: T_χ²(δ) = Σ_i (O'_i - E'_i)² / E'_i (λ=1). 7e883c6 baseline (9/9 byte-identical verified).
focused_scope.g_squared_outside_log_formula_reference: T_G²(δ) = 2 Σ_i O'_i × log(O'_i / E'_i) (λ→0). 9e92b11 baseline (9/9 byte-identical verified).
focused_scope.modified_lr_outside_log_formula_referenc: T_M_LR(δ) = 2 Σ_i E'_i × log(E'_i / O'_i) (λ=-1). 9e39095 baseline (9/9 byte-identical verified).
